column2: A greatsword first given to those who aim to be\nWarriors. Lighter than a normal greatsword, and\nmade to be easy for the less strong to handle.

A longsword first given to those who aim to be
Swordsmen. Its steady edge and easy handling make
it a favorite of many Swordsmen, not only
apprentices.
A leather shield first given to those who aim to be\nSwordsmen. Made with more care for easy handling\nthan for toughness.
A bow first given to those who aim to be Hunters.\nUnlike common hunting bows, it is made for battle.
A crossbow first given to those who aim to be\nHunters. Designed so that even the weak can draw\nits string easily.
A staff first given to those who aim to use magic.\nMade from an aged tree of Elmenas, it aids the\ncaster's power.
Armor first given to those who aim to be Warriors. It\nfavors ease of movement over toughness, and never\nhinders an attack.
Leather armor first given to those who aim to be\nSwordsmen or Hunters. Protects only the vital spots,\nwith ease of movement in mind.
A silver ring given to those who guard Endymion, the\nPale Fortress.
Made of the same material as any ordinary hat and\nwithout any enchantment, yet it holds a strange\npower.
A plume made from the feathers of the sacred Fen\nbird that lives in the Keneone Forest. Prized as a\ncharm for agility and luck.
A blank scroll with nothing written on it. A strange\nscroll on which only high-ranking casters can write.
A greatsword favored by the Sages of Elmenas in\ndays past. Long years spent in the sacred space of\nElmenas let this blade give strength to its bearer.
A longsword favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days\npast. Long years spent in the sacred space of\nElmenas let this blade give strength to its bearer.
A shield favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days\npast. Made from an aged tree of Elmenas, it raises its\nbearer's resistance.
A bow favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days past.\nIts distinctive twang was said to serve as a calling\ncard for a Sage of Elmenas.
A crossbow favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days\npast. It is said that without a Sage's gifts one cannot\neven draw its string.
A staff favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days past.\nIts silver ring, the mark of a Sage of Elmenas, raises\nmagic power.
Armor favored by the Sages of Elmenas in days past.\nA fine suit that defends somewhat against magic as\nwell as physical attacks.
Leather armor favored by the Sages of Elmenas in\ndays past. Designed never to hinder the motions of\nany skill or spell.
A necklace given to Sages leaving Elmenas. In hard\ntimes, Sages gaze at it and draw courage from the\nvow it holds.
Magic gauntlets that shine a silver-white like\nmoonlight. They show their true worth when the\nmoon is in the sky.

An elixir made by the Sage Selan, a master of
medicine. It did not do as Selan intended, so Selan
called it a mere test batch, but its effect was so
splendid that the Academy uses it as a teaching aid.
A charm said to have been made by the Sage Robery,\nin youth, for many women. The motive was impure,\nbut the effect is reliable.
A greatsword made by the Sages of Gospel Brass, the\nacademy where warriors gather. Built for real battle,\nit is too much for those without skill.
A longsword made by a method handed down\namong the warlike Gils tribe. Frightfully light and\nsturdy, it will not tire the arm even if swung all day.
A shield made of star steel, forged under the magic of\nstarlight. It grants its bearer the protection of\nstarlight.
A high-performance bow made by the master\nbowyer Finian. It sold for so much that many fakes,\nalike only in shape, came into circulation.

A crossbow unearthed from the Baal ruins. Though
hundreds of years old, it was found as good as new,
and Sages have long studied how this strange
crossbow was made.
A ceremonial staff used in Elmenas rites. The\nsapphire set in it gives off a soft blue light when a rite\nbegins.
Armor adopted by the knights of Rudan, City of\nTwilight. Rugged and full of weight, it overawes and\noverwhelms all who see it.
Leather armor favored by old Denehere in youth. It\nnot only protects its wearer, but also holds the\npower to invigorate the body.
A gold ring once owned by the king of Falmodes, a\nrealm destroyed by war. It is said to have been worn\nby the king's kin who fled to Elmenas.
Boots made for those on pilgrimage. The holy verses\nwoven into them help on rough roads, letting one\nwalk the pilgrimage without tiring.

A moon crystal orb said to have been made in
childhood by Temira, the great Sage of foresight. It
carries a spell of far sight and lights up great
distances, like the moon in a winter night sky.

A mysterious grimoire. No one knows who wrote it,
when, or why. The book itself has magical power, but
its magical concepts and techniques remain
wrapped in mystery.
A greatsword holding immense power. Under holy\nprotection, it cannot so much as be touched by the\nguilty, and it punishes them for their sins.
A curved sword modeled on the silver wings of the\nlegendary bird Mithrat. Those who fight with it are\nsaid to look as if dancing on beating silver wings.
A shield made of moon steel, forged under the magic\nof moonlight. It grants its bearer the protection of\nmoonlight.

A demon-breaking bow that gained magic by slaying
many Crawlers in the battle nine years ago. It is said
that those without the courage to face Chaos cannot
even draw its string.

A powerful crossbow said to have been used by the
Sage Leda. Even a frail arm can draw it with ease,
and it has the force to sink a small boat with one
shot.
A staff modeled on two entwined snakes. The snakes\namplify the magic from the ruby at its tip, supplying\ngreat magic power to the bearer.
Armor favored by the Sage Yelt. Perhaps through the\nguardianship of Yelt, a master of evasion, it helps its\nwearer dodge attacks.
Leather armor blessed at St. Sevies. The blessing\nraises the wearer's physical abilities and strengthens\nresistance.
A magic scroll written by a high-ranking fire mage. Its\nletters ever flicker like flame, and give power to the\nbearer.
A magic scroll written by a high-ranking water mage.\nIts letters ever shine like clear water, and give power\nto the bearer.
A magic scroll written by a high-ranking earth mage.\nIts letters ever glow a deep forest green, and give\npower to the bearer.
A magic scroll written by a high-ranking wind mage.\nIts letters ever shine like lightning, and give power to\nthe bearer.
A huge curved sword still used for executions in\nBeldraki. It has the weight and edge to take off a\nhead in one blow.
A longsword with a distinctive blade that cuts the\nwind. A barrier of wind around the sword raises the\nbearer's reflexes.

A beautiful white round shield with gold trim.
Painted white with a medicine made from
white-night grass, found only on the Hermes Plain, it
gives its bearer high resistance.

A blue bow used by Gorgan, the Sage of the bow. It
was lost after Gorgan's death, but was found some
years ago and donated to Elmenas, which had
produced Gorgan.
A black-lacquered crossbow said to have been used\nfor assassination. Light and easy to carry, yet deadly,\nits silent bolts made many dignitaries tremble.
The golden dragon wing staff favored by the Sage\nFald. It was sealed and hidden, so as to reach the\nhands of one who inherits Fald's will.
Holy armor presented by the Papal Court of Worth.\nThe Pope's blessing wraps its wearer in a holy aura.

Leather armor made from the hide of the winged
beast Mani of the Darowana Marsh. The Mani
feathers lining the armor make it light and absorb
shocks.
A ritual ring said to have been used without fail by\nthe Sage Nell in magical rites. It excels at the magic\nrecovery that aids casters.
Cuts off those wrapped in this mantle from every\ncalamity of the outside world, and heals the flesh.
A holy book spelling out verses of light in ancient\nWhite Elvish. It is said to grant the wisdom of light to\nany who fully understand it.
A holy book spelling out verses of darkness in\nancient White Elvish. It is said to grant the wisdom of\ndarkness to any who fully understand it.

A holy greatsword carried only by holy knights of
Hyverios, an old house of the East's Four Royal
Houses. Swear an oath on it, and its holy spirit gives
you strength.

A curved sword that became a demon blade after
drinking much blood. For now the barrier of Elmenas
keeps its curse quiet, and only its pure power can be
drawn out.

A holy shield holding the oath of the Four Great
Schools. It serves as a ritual vessel in rites at the
Central Schoolhouse, where the Four Great Schools
meet.

A bow said to have been used in youth by the Sage
Bernaresin Winfy, called the Bow God of Dahatma.
Made from a sacred tree deep in the Forest of
Wandering, it is blessed by the wind spirits.
A holy crossbow made of holy silver. Those who see\nthe flash of Velcross are always struck by its bolt,\nhence its other name, White Flash.
A magic staff found in the home of the Sage Rakia, a\nfamed collector of magic staves. It seems to have\nbeen a treasured piece of the collection.

Armor worn by the dragon knights called the
guardian gods of Dimaggio, the great city of wyverns.
The dragon's blood in the armor brings out the
wearer's potential.
Chainmail made of holy silver. The blessing of the\nholy verses woven in with the silver is said to purify\nthe wearer's heart.

A necklace worn by the Sage Tess, sung of as a
peerless beauty, on setting out on pilgrimage. Tess
died young, and the necklace is said to have
returned by itself to a lover in Elmenas.
A robe the Sage Karen wore for rites. It is enchanted\nto support stamina, so as to endure long\nceremonies.

A magic lens made by Temira, the great Sage of
foresight. It has the strange power of drawing the
contents of a treasure chest seen through it toward
something more valuable.
A holy charm made by Zilmea, head of St. Sevies. It\ncan raise a high-order barrier, allowing one to stand\nagainst Chaos for longer.

A two-bladed greatsword made by the weapon
inventor Igron. Sound resonating between the
blades sets them finely vibrating, so it can cleave
even the hardest thing with ease.

A rapier from the ruins of ancient Estoria, held by
one of seven demon statues guarding the king's
coffin. After over 1000 years it still shines, keen
enough to pierce steel.

A shield carried by those who guard Iria, the
Watchtower that is Paladine's castle. Combining
shining steel and moon crystal into a mirror-like
form, it is highly effective against spells.
A magic bow protected by wind spirits. The arrows it\nlooses ride the wind, and are said to chase a target\nanywhere.

A rapid-fire crossbow made by the weapon inventor
Igron. It loads bolts easily, and its speed of fire more
than makes up for reduced force, raising attack
power overall.

A magic staff carried by the Sages of Paladine. Made
from a sacred tree native to the Watchtower's
surroundings, grown amid waves of magic, it greatly
benefits casters using spells.
Heavy armor of shining steel, forged from a blend of\nstar steel and holy silver. Beautiful and sturdy, it is an\nhonored suit that all who aim to be Warriors long for.

Leather armor made from the hide of the unicorn
lion said to appear on the old battlefield of Amangio.
The fighting spirit that lingers in the leather
invigorates the wearer's body.
A bewitching ring that stirs its bearer's desires. Those\nwho can stay calm while wearing it are said to bring\nout its true worth.

Holy gauntlets that only the holy knights of Hyverios,
an ancient house among the Four Royal Houses of
the East, may carry. The protection of the verses
carved on them guards against magical attacks.
A strange egg with a jade shell. No one even knows\nwhether it was made or laid by some creature, and it\nhas long been a subject of study for Sages.
A silver key found in the Shrine of the Scales. No lock\nin Elmenas fits it. It seems to bear some\nenchantment, but even that remains unexplained.
A rare curved sword presented by Frazetta, an\nacademy of the West. Made by a method unknown in\nthe East, it has an unbelievably keen edge.

A rapier carried by the dragon knights called the
guardian gods of Dimaggio, the great city of wyverns.
Its spiral blade is keen enough to pierce even dragon
scales.

A jet-black shield made from the tough scales of the
Black King Bug, a magic beast of the Forest of
Wandering. The strong, supple scales absorb any
shock and ease the burden on the bearer.
A pure white bow said to draw out its owner's\npotential. It is said that one with a Sage's gifts could\neven hit a chosen point far, far away.

A golden crossbow that can fire the power of the soul
on its bolts. It does not wear away the bearer's soul;
the stronger the wish or oath held in the soul, the
greater its force.

A holy silver staff set with moonlight stone, said to
have fallen from the moon. Much about the stone
remains a mystery, and its great magic still stirs the
curiosity of Sages.

Mysterious armor said to have been guarded by the
magic dragon Glen in the Endless Labyrinth. As if
alive, it always gives off fighting spirit, and menaces
all around it.
Chainmail of true silver worn by warriors of the\nElves, a rare tribe. Though made of metal, it is a rare\nmail that can receive the protection of spirits.

A necklace made by the master craftsman Attezam
when near death. Attezam's will dwells in it as magic,
and for this Attezam was entered in the lowest seat
among Sages.
Magic greaves bearing a lightening spell. Though\nimmensely heavy, they are said to feel to the wearer\nas though wearing nothing at all.

An elixir made by the Sage Selan, a master of
medicine. A potion so strong that even Selan
declared no better could be made; it is said to be
poison to those without the gift.
A true gold bell that announces the start of the Silver\nBell Festival. Not only a ritual vessel, it holds strong\nmagic that raises its bearer's magic power.

A huge sword said to have been used lifelong by
Detoile, the great swordsman of the North. After the
legendary slaying of 100 magic beasts, it is said to
have gained the power of a demon blade.
A longsword said to have been carried by a warrior of\nan ancient tribe who once commanded griffins. Not\nonly is it keen, it also holds a special magic.

A dragon scale shield carried by the dragon knights
called the guardian gods of Dimaggio, the great city
of wyverns. Not only sturdy, it is said to block any
dragon's breath.
A longbow that can aim at a distance beyond what\nits user's strength would suggest. It is enchanted to\ninvigorate the bearer's body for long-range shots.
A special crossbow that excels in defense as well as\nattack. Its bearer can keep firing without fear of\napproaching enemies.

A double-headed staff made by the weapon inventor
Igron. The moon crystals at its two ends ever
resonate, supplying its bearer with immense magic
power.

Armor worn by the Sage Lambach, of whom no one
knows where they came from or where they went.
Those who wear it are said to hear, now and then, a
voice speaking to them.
Leather armor of the highest order, made from the\nhide of the Beast King Gadil Lord. It is said that no\nmagic beast's fang can pierce it.
A ring beloved and protected by fire spirits. It gives\nits wearer destructive power like a blaze piercing the\nheavens.
A ring beloved and protected by water spirits. It gives\nits wearer magic as pure as a welling spring.
A ring beloved and protected by wind spirits. It gives\nits wearer speed like a gale racing across the\ngrassland.
A ring beloved and protected by earth spirits. It gives\nits wearer toughness like the unshakable earth.

A huge blade forged with the ashes of Danhel, famed
for reckless courage. Danhel's soul lives in the blade,
giving madness to the weak and greater power to the
strong.
The supreme sword reached at last by the Sage\nHaltina, sung of as a Sword Saint. Sword in hand,\nHaltina went on to devise many techniques.
A clawed shield made by the weapon inventor Igron.\nBuilt with the huge claws of the demon ape Gora, it\nserves in attack as well as defense.

A great bow said to have been used by a nameless
hero of Cliffcaled in the South. Its arrows split the
sky with a sound like a roar, and so it came to be
called the Howling Bow.

The newest crossbow by the weapon inventor Igron.
Unmatched in attack power, rate of fire and
accuracy, it is a masterpiece so fine that its maker
gave it Igron's own name.

The supreme magic staff handed down in the
Beldraki imperial house. It went missing amid the
many wars Beldraki started, and a vast bounty is
offered for it.

Armor of the Sage Feriam, who stood against the
Crawlers with deadly resolve nine years ago. It drove
them back even after Feriam's death, and holds that
resolve still.

Red silver chainmail said to have been worn by
ancient White Elf warriors. The art of making red
silver, which gives off its own magic, is now lost,
making this one of the most precious armors.
A magic ring that has refused the protection of every\nspirit. It holds only pure magic power, relying on no\nspirit.
Magic gauntlets that shine a golden light like the sun.\nThey show their true worth when the sun is in the\nsky.
A ring beloved and protected by light spirits. It gives\nits wearer the protection of holy light, like warm\nsunshine.
A ring beloved and protected by dark spirits. It gives\nits wearer the protection of darkness, like a sky of\neternal night.

A greatsword said to have been owned by the Spirit
King of Earth. Its blade of solid earth spirit power
never breaks, and holds the immense power to split
the ground.

A longsword said to have been owned by the Spirit
King of Earth. Its blade of solid earth spirit power
never breaks, and it is said there is nothing born of
the earth that it cannot cut.
A great shield said to have been owned by the Spirit\nKing of Earth. Its plating of solid earth spirit power is\neverlastingly hard, and nothing can break it.

A mighty bow said to have been owned by the Spirit
King of Earth. It draws in the power of the earth,
invigorating its bearer's body and making them a
master of the mighty bow.

A great crossbow said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Earth. It draws in the power of the
earth, invigorating its bearer's mind and making
them an expert with the great crossbow.
A staff said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nEarth. It is said to hold earth spells both lost and yet\nundiscovered.
Heavy armor said to have been worn by the Spirit\nKing of Earth. The power within ever reshapes the\nland around it, so that its owner may fight with ease.

Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of
Earth. Living armor made from the bark of the sacred
tree Soma, it gives its wearer the strength to
withstand Chaos.

A magic ring found in the tomb of the great Sage
Hometos. Its gem's magic, amplified by the true
silver setting, becomes a phosphorescent barrier
that protects the righteous.
A true silver bracelet kneaded with magic. Some of\nits spells have lost their effect, while others are said\nto await waking within it.

A magic lens made by Temira, the great Sage of
foresight. It has the strange power of drawing the
contents of a treasure chest seen through it toward
something of a higher order.

Magic earrings that a certain Sage meant to give to a
lover, the Sage Tess. They vanished along with the
news of Tess's death, and their whereabouts became
unknown.

A mighty lightning blade said to have been owned by
the Spirit King of Wind. Its blade of solid wind spirit
power carries lightning, and its blows have the
destructive power of a thunderbolt.

A curved wind sword said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Wind. Its blade of solid wind spirit
power is light as a feather, and is said to raise a wind
when swung.

A shield said to have been owned by the Spirit King
of Wind. Its plating of solid wind spirit power is very
light, and the attacks of the weak are turned aside by
the wind around it without touching the shield.
A longbow said to have been owned by the Spirit\nKing of Wind. Its arrows wear a gust of wind, and can\nsurely bring down distant foes.
A longbow said to have been owned by the Spirit\nKing of Wind. Its arrows raise a whirlwind, and those\nthey strike are torn by blades of vacuum.
A staff said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nWind. It is said to hold wind spells both lost and yet\nundiscovered.

Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of
Wind. Those who become high-ranking Sages and
are accepted by the armor are said to gain the power
of flight.
Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of\nWind. Woven of solid wind spirit power, it grants its\nwearer the protection of high resistance.

A magic ring owned by Temira, the great Sage of
foresight. Temira always wore it when making
prophecies, and so it came to be called the Ring of
Foresight.
A magic chalice said to fill with the blood of saints as\nthe end draws near. Those who drink holy water\nfrom it gain resistance to Chaos.

A magic mirror made by Galent, Commander of
Paladine two generations past. Its blend of shining
steel and moon crystal later gave rise to Paladine's
shield, known as the Spire Mirror.
A gold key found in the Shrine of the Scales. No lock\nin Elmenas fits it. It seems to bear some\nenchantment, but even that remains unexplained.

A crystal greatsword said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Water. Its blade of solid water spirit
power has a delicate crystal shine, but its blows are
as mighty as a waterfall.
An ice rapier said to have been owned by the Spirit\nKing of Water. Its blade, cut from an everlasting\nglacier, freezes and shatters what it touches.

A round water-mirror shield said to have been
owned by the Spirit King of Water. Its plating of solid
water spirit power reflects all ailments, and raises its
bearer's resistance.

A flowing-water short bow said to have been owned
by the Spirit King of Water. It looses shots like a
raging torrent, which its body, lovely as a water's
surface, would never suggest.
A clear-water crossbow said to have been owned by\nthe Spirit King of Water. Its bolts of spray can easily\npierce even hard bedrock.
A staff said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nWater. It is said to hold water spells both lost and yet\nundiscovered.
Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of\nWater. Wrapped in icy air, it is said to instantly freeze\nand shatter any weak one who tries to touch it.
Armor said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nWater. Chainmail woven of everlasting glacier ice, its\nmagic greatly raises its wearer's stamina.

A magic hat favored by the mysterious witch Mamel.
It carries a spell of far sight, and holds Mamel's
memories, which are said to grant much knowledge
to the gifted.
A magic robe favored by the mysterious witch\nMamel. Excellent in magic defense, it protects its\nwearer from many dangerous spells.
A magic mantle favored by the mysterious witch\nMamel. It is very sturdy and never tears. Neither torn\nnor soiled, it always keeps its vivid, as-new color.
Magic boots favored by the mysterious witch Mamel.\nTheir wearer receives the protection of wind, and\ncan move more lightly and quickly than usual.

A scorching greatsword said to have been owned by
the Spirit King of Fire. Its blade of solid fire spirit
power gives off heat that turns the wicked to ash in
an instant.

A blazing longsword said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Fire. Its blade of solid fire spirit power
is ever aflame, and the heat haze it raises warps the
blade's path, making it hard to dodge.

A holy fire shield said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Fire. Fire spirit power invigorates its
bearer's stamina and magic, giving the strength to
fight Chaos for a long time.

A great flame bow said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Fire. Its fire-bearing arrows burst into
flame on impact, turning the weak to cinders in an
instant.
A mighty flame crossbow said to have been owned\nby the Spirit King of Fire. Its bolts of holy flame burn\nup Chaos, and go on burning until nothing is left.
A staff said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nFire. It is said to hold fire spells both lost and yet\nundiscovered.

Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of
Fire. It is ever white-hot, and any who touch it
without its acceptance are wrapped in flame in an
instant.
Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of\nFire. Made from the hide of a flame demon, it is said\nto let its wearer move freely even inside fire.

A gem of darkness that can only be made in the
Chamber of Eternal Night, deep within Fandispere.
Wearing it wraps you in a barrier of darkness that
guards the heart from the sweet words of Chaos.
A true gold bracelet said to be awarded to the finest\nSage of Paladine. Only the talented can draw out the\npower hidden in it.
A glass statue modeled on the Zola, a phantom rare\nbeast that vanished long ago. A lost art is said to be\nhidden in its lapis-blue glass.

A mysterious grimoire written in a language unlike
any on earth, or any script of the past. It is said to
record all fates, but the one Sage who deciphered it
mysteriously vanished, so the truth is unknown.

A greatsword of eternal night said to have been
owned by the Spirit King of Darkness. Its blade of
solid dark spirit power is said to cut not the flesh, but
the heart.

A longsword of the unenlightened dark said to have
been owned by the Spirit King of Darkness. It closes
its bearer's eyes; this mighty sword can only be fully
wielded by one who has opened the mind's eye.

A shield of darkness said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Darkness. Too heavy for the weak to
handle, but those who master it are said to have an
invincible shield that melts any attack into the dark.

A jet-black great bow said to have been owned by
the Spirit King of Darkness. The protection of
darkness lets its bearer stand against Chaos for
longer.

A crossbow of silence said to have been owned by
the Spirit King of Darkness. The protection of
darkness lets its bearer stand against Chaos for
longer.
A staff said to have been owned by the Spirit King of\nDarkness. It is said to hold verses of darkness both\nlost and yet undiscovered.
Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of\nDarkness. It takes away its wearer's sight, and in\nreturn grants the protection of strong resistance.

Armor said to have been worn by the Spirit King of
Darkness. Stripped from a high being called a
Demon King, its hide still lives, and watches for a
chance to take over its wearer.
A magic stone holding high-purity fire spirit power.\nOverflowing fire spirit power keeps invigorating its\nowner's body, healing any wound instantly.
A magic stone holding high-purity water spirit power.\nOverflowing water spirit power releases its owner's\npotential, allowing them to handle much magic.
A magic stone holding high-purity wind spirit power.\nOverflowing wind spirit power amplifies its owner's\nmind and supplies magic power.
A magic stone holding high-purity earth spirit power.\nOverflowing earth spirit power strengthens its\nowner's flesh, giving a stalwart body.

A red-light greatsword said to have been owned by
the Spirit King of Light. It lights the bearer's
surroundings with holy light, letting them sense the
presence of Chaos early.
A blue-light longsword said to have been owned by\nthe Spirit King of Light. The holy light it gives off\nexposes even hidden Chaos.

A green-light shield said to have been owned by the
Spirit King of Light. Wrapped in holy light, its
surroundings are ever bright as midday, and no
Chaos can hide.
A purple-light longbow said to have been owned by\nthe Spirit King of Light. A holy bow that endlessly\nmakes arrows of light said to pierce any obstacle.

An orange-light crossbow said to have been owned
by the Spirit King of Light. A holy crossbow that
endlessly makes bolts of light said to strike a foe in
an instant, however far away.
A yellow-light staff said to have been owned by the\nSpirit King of Light. It is said to hold verses of light\nboth lost and yet undiscovered.
White-light armor said to have been worn by the\nSpirit King of Light. Under holy protection and highly\nversatile, it has the power to withstand any attack.

Deep-blue-light armor said to have been worn by the
Spirit King of Light. The nameless saint who became
this armor gives strength to the righteous, and drives
Chaos from the heart.

A magic necklace that Ney received from a friend
who went to Innocentia. Bearing a charm of far sight
toward Innocentia, it always points in Innocentia's
direction.

A magic orb in which earth, wind, water, fire,
darkness and light all mingle and clash. It gives its
bearer great power, but no one can tell when it might
burst.

A magic stone holding high-purity light spirit power.
Overflowing light spirit power strengthens and
invigorates its owner's body, granting protection that
makes even a caster a fighter.

A magic stone holding high-purity dark spirit power.
Overflowing dark spirit power strengthens and
invigorates its owner's mind, granting protection
that makes even a fighter a caster.
